name: selene
description: Selene : carnet personnel local-first (artefact claude.ai, PWA).

scripts.test:syntax: for f in src/*.js src/native/*.js src/core/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: python3 build.py --bundle .lint/selene.js && eslint .lint/selene.js src/core scripts src/native sw.js
scripts.test:functions: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/*/index.ts && deno test --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/
scripts.check: npm run build:check && npm test && npm run test:syntax && npm run lint && npm run test:functions
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:browser
